title: RecallRequest
description: Input contract for crystalium.recall(). Recall is universally allowed (Tier × Layer matrix row 'any/recall'). Read-side trust is propagated via D7 min(inputs.tier), not gated here. scope.project is required: recall never guesses a cross-project scope.

scope.description: Project-isolation filter. Provide a non-empty project, for example {"project": "crystalium", "agent_class_visibility": "vigil"}.

project.description: Non-empty project identifier. Results are limited to this project.

agent_class_visibility.description: Optional agent-class visibility filter, such as an Eidolon name.

sensitivity_tag.description: Sensitivity filter applied by the redactor before results are returned.

query.description: Natural-language probe for hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval.

k.description: Maximum number of results to return.

layers.description: Memory layers to search. Default (absent) = all four layers.
